payload.core_mechanism_summary: Identifies up to two contiguous violation blocks. If too many violations, returns 0. Otherwise, tries swaps among critical indices and their neighbors, checking validity in O(1) per swap.
payload.rationale: The code prunes the search by returning 0 when violations exceed a small threshold, analogous to bounding. It branches over candidate swaps from a reduced set. Other subtypes like backtracking or permutation enumeration do not fit the ad-hoc pruning and fixed-index focus.
